Risk Description: Former employees may retain active system accounts
Recommended Action: Develop a formal employee offboarding procedure, disable accounts promptly after termination, and introduce periodic access reviews.
Required Remediation Evidence: Approved offboarding procedure, account deactivation records, access review reports

Risk Description: Employees may fall victim to phishing attacks
Recommended Action: Conduct regular phishing simulations, provide targeted security awareness training, and track employee performance.
Required Remediation Evidence: Training attendance records, phishing simulation reports, improvement metrics

Risk Description: Sensitive customer data may be exposed through misconfigured AWS S3 storage
Recommended Action: Enforce S3 Block Public Access, review bucket policies and ACLs, validate effective access permissions, and monitor configuration changes.
Required Remediation Evidence: S3 Block Public Access configuration evidence, bucket policy review, access validation results, CloudTrail records

Recommended Action: Review endpoint protection coverage, strengthen endpoint security configurations, update incident response procedures, and conduct ransomware response exercises.
Required Remediation Evidence: Endpoint protection coverage report, updated incident response plan, ransomware exercise report

Risk Description: Security incidents may go undetected because logs are not consistently reviewed
Recommended Action: Establish centralised log monitoring, configure security alerts, define escalation procedures, and maintain documented log review records.
Required Remediation Evidence: Logging configuration evidence, alert rules, monitoring reports, documented review records

Risk Description: A third-party payment processor may expose customer information
Recommended Action: Conduct a formal vendor security assessment, review relevant security evidence, strengthen contractual security requirements, and establish periodic vendor reviews.
Required Remediation Evidence: Completed vendor assessment, reviewed security documentation, contractual security clauses, vendor review records

Risk Description: Backups may be unavailable or unusable during recovery
Recommended Action: Establish scheduled backup restoration tests, validate backup integrity, document recovery procedures, and assess recovery time and recovery point objectives.
Required Remediation Evidence: Backup restoration test results, backup integrity reports, recovery procedure documentation, RTO and RPO test results

Risk Description: Unpatched vulnerabilities may allow attackers to compromise systems
Recommended Action: Establish vulnerability remediation deadlines based on severity, maintain a remediation tracker, and escalate overdue vulnerabilities.
Required Remediation Evidence: Vulnerability scan reports, patch records, remediation tracker, overdue vulnerability reports
